steps.title: Why Use Unreliable Narration?
steps.body: • Creates suspense and mystery • Forces reader to question everything • Shows gap between perception and reality • Reveals character through what they hide

steps.title: Technique + Quotation + Effect = Full Marks
steps.body: When writing about novel techniques, never just name the method. Every paragraph must identify the technique, quote evidence, and explain the effect on the reader. For AO2, examiners reward analysis of how the writer manipulates narrative to shape meaning — not just what the story is about, but how it is told.

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: Stream of consciousness captures the continuous flow of thoughts without logical organisation. Authors use it to create psychological realism, show inner experience, and immerse readers in character's | Signs of unreliable narration: contradictions in their story; other characters disagree; events don't match description; they admit to lying or forgetting; excessive self-justification. | Symbolism: objects representing ideas (conch = order). Allegory: entire story represents abstract ideas or political situations (island = world, characters = aspects of human nature).
